dct_description_sm: This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada.This spatial data is census Designated Places (DP) geography, for the Durham census division (CD). Designated Places describe small communities that exist at the sub-municipal level. The column "DPLUID" can be used to identify specific DP's and to link to other census tables that aggregate or enumerate at the level of the Designated Place.
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Designated Places Boundary
